messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Esperanto, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Esperanto line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|------------------|--------| | Tant' | “so” (intensifier) | Tiom | “so” | OK | | è | copular “is” | estas | “is” | OK | | amara | “bitter” | amara | “bitter” | OK | | che | complementizer “that” | ke | “that” | OK | | poco | “little, slightly” | iom | “a little” | OK | | è | copular “is” (second clause) | estas | “is” | OK | | più | comparative “more” | pli | “more” | OK | | morte | “death” | morto | “death” | OK | | ma | coordinating “but” | Sed | “but” | OK | | per | preposition of purpose “for / in order to” | **per** | “by/through” | **WRONG** (Esperanto uses **por** for purpose) | | trattar | infinitive “to treat / to discuss” | trakti | “to treat” | OK | | del | “of the” (preposition + article) | **pri** | “about” | **WRONG** (should be **de la**) | | ben | “good” (the thing to be discussed) | bono | “good” | OK | | ch' | relative pronoun “that / which” | kiun | “that/which” | OK | | i' | first‑person pronoun “I” | mi | “I” | OK | | vi | locative adverb “there” | tie | “there” | OK | | trovai | past “found” | trovis | “found” | OK | | dirò | future “I will say / tell” | Mi diros | “I will say” | OK | | de | preposition “of / about” | **pri** | “about” | **WRONG** (should be **de** or **pri** depending on sense; here the source means “of”, so **de** would be more literal) | | l'altre | “the other” | la aliaj | “the other” | OK | | cose | “things” | aferoj | “things” | OK | | ch' | relative pronoun “that / which” | kiujn | “that/which” | OK | | i' | first‑person pronoun “I” | mi | “I” | OK | | v' | locative adverb “there” | tie | “there” | OK | | ho | auxiliary for perfect (no lexical meaning) | — (absorbed in past tense) | — | OK | | scorte | past participle “seen” | vidis | “saw / have seen” | OK |
---
### Items that need correction
| Source Word | Issue | |-------------|-------| | **per** (line 8) | Used **per** in Esperanto, which expresses “by/through”. The source preposition denotes purpose (“for / in order to”). The correct Esperanto preposition is **por**. | | **del** (line 8) | Rendered as **pri** (“about”). The literal sense is “of the”, which should be **de la** in Esperanto. | | **de** (line 9) | Rendered as **pri**. The source preposition is a simple “of”. A more literal translation would be **de** (or **pri** if the sense is “about”), but the mismatch is flagged as **WRONG** for strict lexical alignment. |
All other lexical items are correctly aligned and grammatically acceptable.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Esperanto script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Esperanto text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 7** - Original: Tiom amara estas ĝi ke morto estas iom pli; - Issue: none - Corrected: Tiom amara estas ĝi ke morto estas iom pli;
- **Line 8** - Original: Sed per tratti pri la bono kiun mi trovis tie, - Issue: “per” should be **por** (purpose); “tratti” should be **trakti** (infinitive). - Corrected: Sed por trakti pri la bono kiun mi trovis tie,
- **Line 9** - Original: Mi diros de l'altre cose kiujn mi tie vidis. - Issue: “de” should be **pri** (about); “l'altre” → **la aliaj**; “cose” → **aferoj**. - Corrected: Mi diros pri la aliaj aferoj kiujn mi tie vidis.
